title: Statistical Analysis Tools Used in Datasets
summary: Datasets are checked using the Shapiro–Wilk test, a statistical method for normality testing. This cluster includes various tools used in statistical analysis, including the Bonferroni correction, Kruskal–Wallis test, and Mann–Whitney U-test. Additionally, it includes software packages such as GraphPad, Microsoft Office Professional Plus 2021, and SPSS 27.0, as well as specific applications like PowerPoint and Prism 8. The presence of SPSS Inc. suggests a commercial entity behind the software package SPSS 27.0.
